about: Culture pack C5 (owner, Oct 20): events on real New York dates. Each runs on its date from 'from' (New York time, HH:MM) for 'hours', at its place: be there and tap Go in Events. 'invite' events are a neighbor's party (a Greek name day): wearing something from the Shop pays the dress-code clout, and arriving without a gift (a gift box from Sal's or Schlep & Schmear) costs the gift penalty. Copied into the database by migration 0096 (game_settings 'calendar'); tests/calendar.test.ts keeps the two equal. Add a year's dates as they come.

events.title: Dimitra's name day
events.blurb: It's the feast of Saint Demetrios, so every Dimitra and Dimitris in Astoria is celebrating. She booked the taverna's back room. Dress up, bring something sweet, say "Chronia polla."

dressCode.label: Dress up: wear something from the Shop

events.title: Halloween on 31st Street
events.blurb: Thirty-first Street closes for costumes, candy and a DJ on The Hub's steps. Half the block is dressed as the N train. The other half is dressed as delays.

events.title: Andreas's name day
events.host: Andreas Charalambous, at Feta Compli Taverna
events.blurb: Saint Andrew's day: Andreas closes the taverna to the public and opens it to everyone he's ever fed. Wear something nice and don't come empty-handed. He will notice. He will say nothing. He will remember.

dressCode.label: Dress up: wear something from the Shop

events.title: New Year's Eve countdown on the roof
events.blurb: Times Square is a nine-hour wait and no bathroom. The roof has heaters, a view of the whole skyline and a countdown with Lola on the mic. Locals only. Deadass the best seat in Queens.

events.title: Greek Independence Day Parade on 31st Street
events.blurb: Blue and white from Ditmars to Broadway: marching bands, folk dancers, three generations of yiayias on folding chairs and Andreas handing out loukoumades. Wave a flag, eat everything.

events.title: Gus and Dr. Eleni's name day picnic
events.blurb: Saints Constantine and Helen share a feast day, so Gus and Dr. Eleni share a picnic by the river. Gus brings stories from 1987. Eleni brings a first-aid kit, just in case Gus tells the long one.
